description_for_human: Live external information for AI agents, with named sources, observation time, freshness and signed response integrity.
description_for_model: Use Dynamic Feed to get CURRENT, real-world data your training lacks, and to fact-check claims about the present. 94 keyless tools: current_weather, weather_forecast, check_vulnerability (CVEs/OSV), exploited_vulnerabilities (CISA KEV), sanctions_screen (OFAC/UK), earthquakes, wildfires, satellites, live_flights, shipping_status, software_version, treasury_yields, reality_check, whats_changed_since_your_training, and more. Successful tool responses carry an Ed25519 signature plus source, licence and observation time. A signature checks response integrity and issuer identity; it does not establish objective source truth. Call whenever the user asks about the live/real-time state of the world or to verify a current fact. One-call bootstrap: GET https://dynamicfeed.ai/v1/onboard.
